title: Job: I Will Argue My Case

questions.question: What does Job call his friends?
questions.explanation: Job 13:4 (ESV): "As for you, you whitewash with lies; worthless physicians are you all."

questions.question: Who does Job desire to argue his case with?
questions.explanation: Job 13:3 (ESV): "But I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to argue my case with God."

questions.question: What would be their wisdom?
questions.explanation: Job 13:5 (ESV): "Oh that you would keep silent, and it would be your wisdom!"

questions.question: Though he slay me, I will what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:15 (ESV): "Though he slay me, I will hope in him; yet I will argue my ways to his face."

questions.question: If I hold my peace, what will happen?
options: I shall give up the ghost/die
questions.correctAnswer: I shall give up the ghost/die
questions.explanation: Job 13:19 (ESV): "Who is there that will contend with me? For then I would be silent and die."

questions.question: Will you speak falsely for whom?
questions.explanation: Job 13:7 (ESV): "Will you speak falsely for God and speak deceitfully for him?"

questions.question: Your maxims are proverbs of what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:12 (ESV): "Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay."

questions.question: Let me have silence, and I will speak, and let come on me what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:13 (ESV): "Let me have silence, and I will speak, and let come on me what may."

questions.question: Where does Job take his flesh?
questions.explanation: Job 13:14 (ESV): "Why should I take my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my hand?"

questions.question: The godless shall not come before whom?
questions.explanation: Job 13:16 (ESV): "This will be my salvation, that the godless shall not come before him."

questions.question: What two things does Job ask God to do (or not do)?
options: Withdraw your hand and let not dread terrify me
questions.correctAnswer: Withdraw your hand and let not dread terrify me
questions.explanation: Job 13:21 (ESV): "Withdraw your hand far from me, and let not your dread terrify me."

questions.question: Make me know my transgression and my what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:23 (ESV): "How many are my iniquities and my sins? Make me know my transgression and my sin."

questions.question: Why do you hide your face and count me as your what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:24 (ESV): "Why do you hide your face and count me as your enemy?"

questions.question: Will you frighten a driven what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:25 (ESV): "Will you frighten a driven leaf and pursue dry chaff?"

questions.question: You put my feet in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 13:27 (ESV): "You put my feet in the stocks and watch all my paths..."

key_verse_text: Though he slay me, I will hope in him; yet I will argue my ways to his face.
